verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Jan runs local models through a llama.cpp-powered server, so exposing engine settings is a fair question. However, no evidence item documents user-overridable low-level engine parameters such as memory locking (mlock) or mmap. The generic "full control" tagline and the API server prefix/host settings are adjacent features and do not show engine-level configuration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
